text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Approaching the fourth corner and into the final stretch!
Which Umamusume will take the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAHH!!
—YAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or and Chrono Genesis!
Are they making their move from here!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (—Everyone, watch me.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm gonna win!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Loves Only You!!
Loves Only You has seized the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: An undefeated Oaks Umamusume is borrrrn!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I won—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I, did it……――I did it……!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"‘YEAAAAAAAH!!’ ‘She won!!!’
‘WOOOOOOO!!’ ‘Loves-chan ;;;;’
‘Best day of my life’ ‘CONGRATULATIONS!!!!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! The Undefeated Queen came through...!!
This year's Tiara Umamusume are just way too insane!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
First Gran Alegria, and now this... What is going on this year!?
Whoa~! I can't wait to see what happens next!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...You're really strong, Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even so—
I will never give up the mile...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...
Loves-san...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I think I will follow your example, too.
The way you hold your feelings...—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —...Congratulations, Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan...!
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I... I think Love-chan's run today... her victory...
will go down in racing history as something truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: But... that is precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I feel... frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The fact that I couldn't beat you... today—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...... The 『Shuka Sho』.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And there, I will surely... win.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I will... prove to history... that I am an Umamusume who creates this era too...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Chrono-chan really is so lovey.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If we end up competing again...
I won't lose either. I swear it on my love.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...That's our Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-kuun!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Loves!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-chaaan!!”
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Loves!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Take this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You suddenly throws her arms around me.
It was so completely unexpected that—
choice_data_list: L-Loves...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —It's the victory of our love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After whispering that into my ear,
Loves Only You pulled away—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――... Aha, I got a little overwhelmed with emotion♪
choice_data_list: T-That's bad for my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Does that mean your heart was racing that much? In that case, the surprise was a total success♡"

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Loves! Loves! Loves! Loves! Loves! Loves! Loves! Loves!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Waah, amazing...!
choice_data_list: ...Everyone here is a witness to your love.
...Everyone here is a witness to your love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Then we have to respond together.
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: After all, it's the running style I built together with you, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "After all, it's the running style we built together, Trainer-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Oaks, which had been her primary goal,
concluded in the best possible way—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You was hosting a stream in the Trainer's Room as an Oaks victory celebration—

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"That final stretch was incredible!" "Way too cool!"
"First time I cried watching a race." ";;;;"
"Congratulations!!!" "A memory of a lifetime!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you all so much,
as always, for cheering me on.
Really, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to run with
so much love today...!
It gave me sooo much strength during the race too♡

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna cry ;;" "Glad I could help!"
"The love came through!" "Thank you for the emotion!"
"Right back at you, received the best love ever!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I received the absolute best love."
Waaah, I'm so happy...!
We're sharing so much love with each other, aren't we♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...There's one more person I want everyone
to send some love to, though...
Can you guess who it is~?"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Of course!" "The MVP!"
"She was crying a bit after the race, wasn't she? lol"
"Miss Bridge!" "Our beloved bridge!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that was way too easy~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, thanks to Trainer-kun's encouragement,
my nerves melted away, and I was able to turn everyone's cheers into strength."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, thanks to Trainer-chan's encouragement,
my nerves melted away, and I was able to turn everyone's cheers into strength."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, I want all of you to send
Trainer-kun lots and loooots of "thank yous" too♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, I want all of you to send
Trainer-chan lots and loooots of "thank yous" too♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Way to go, bridge-builder!" "Master Trainer!"
"Thank you for supporting Loves!"
"I'm so proud of you too!" "Looking forward to what's next!"
choice_data_list: ...Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♪ That's true love♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the victory celebration stream came to a peaceful close—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah~, that was so much fun...♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The commu-members were happier than ever,
and they gave me so much praise—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I can really tell how happy they are.
choice_data_list: You're the one who put a smile on everyone's face.
You're the one who made everyone smile

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some of the commu-members have been watching
over her since she was little.
...They must be deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Truly a cycle of love♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――……Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――……Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You know, my channel members were showering me with so~ many compliments on stream earlier, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Next time, I want Trainer-kun to praise me♡"
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Next time, I want Trainer-chan to praise me♡"
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Say a few words to the trainee
who just won you the 『Oaks』♪
choice_data_list: Th-That was some seriously cool running!
Th-That was some seriously cool running!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Say a few words to the trainee
who just won you the 『Oaks』♪
choice_data_list: Th-That was some seriously cool running!
Th-That was some seriously cool running!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hmm, be more specific!
choice_data_list: Brilliant tactics from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And what else~?
choice_data_list: And then!? Um, the concert was great too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Anything else~?
choice_data_list: What else?! And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You suddenly began begging for praise,
and for a while after, I gave her all the praise she wanted—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♪ Getting so much praise makes me so happy♡
choice_data_list: Th-That's a relief, then...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then next, I'm going to praise you a whole bunch, Trainer-kun♪
First off—
choice_data_list: B-Before that, shouldn't we decide on your target race!?
B-Before that, shouldn't we decide on your target race!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then next, I'm going to praise you a whole bunch, Trainer-chan♪
First off—
choice_data_list: B-Before that, shouldn't we decide on your target race!?
B-Before that, shouldn't we decide on your target race!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she returned the favor with the exact same intensity, I'd collapse from embarrassment...!
So, I decided to suggest changing the subject.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Come to think of it,
we haven't talked about the specifics yet, have we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Honestly though, it might already be set in stone.
choice_data_list: ...The Shuka Sho, then.
...The Shuka Sho, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 2000m turf middle-distance GⅠ race held at Kyoto Racecourse in October.
...The final crown of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
After this summer, I'll become even stronger
and reach for that final tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And let's celebrate again!
Together with everyone, just like today♪"
choice_data_list: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And with that, our target race is decided!
Now then, time for some praise♪
choice_data_list: Ugh. Do you really have to do it...?!
Ugh. Do you really have to...?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Pretty, pretty please? ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the final crown of autumn,
our journey together with Loves Only You marches onward—
